scripts.serve: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools emulators:start --project demo-no-project --only functions,firestore
scripts.serve:web: npx -y firebase-tools emulators:start --config firebase.sourcing.json --project demo-no-project --only hosting
scripts.serve:web:full: npm run build:sourcing-bundle && npx -y firebase-tools emulators:start --config firebase.sourcing.json --project demo-no-project --only hosting,functions,firestore
scripts.serve:staging: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools emulators:start --project staging --only functions,firestore
scripts.serve:production: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools emulators:start --project production --only functions,firestore
scripts.shell: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools functions:shell
